releases.name: NinMaki
releases.summary: This is different from the general ninja game, because you will play a "ninegg", a novice ninja. There are so few skills that you can't even attack the enemy!? Take advantage of everything around you, avoid a lot of killing, collect broken scrolls, and challenge the final BOSS.

releases.name: Slice of Fortune
releases.summary: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Explore new locations, gather rare fruits, craft refreshing drinks, and serve thirsty customers for profit. Unlock powerful upgrades and grow through a massive skill tree as your shop becomes busier than ever.

releases.name: Antiutopia
releases.summary: Antiutopia is a fast-paced, skill-based multiplayer FPS set in a fractured sci-fi world. Built from the ground up in a custom engine by a solo developer, it delivers classic arena gun-play, tight matches, and pure competitive action. No progression grind, no gimmicks, just skill.

releases.name: Vibe Train
releases.summary: A cozy, casual train-themed desktop idle game. Explore the world by rail. Equip a variety of train cars, and grow crops, haul cargo, trade goods, and carry passengers along the way.

releases.name: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together is a cozy first-person sorting game. Put 2,304 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes. Play alone or with up to three friends, learn useful abilities, assemble paintings and bring the theatre back to life.

releases.name: Ghost Girl Requiem
releases.summary: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices you make in each chapter shape the story's final ending.

releases.name: 1000 Milliarden Dollar - Kohle und Stahl
releases.summary: Essen, 1807: Grow your family business into an industrial conglomerate. Trade, manufacture, and invest in new technology. In this turn-based business and family simulation, you’ll guide your dynasty through wars and crises until 1933—and decide who will carry on your life’s work.

releases.name: Charmosaic
releases.summary: Relax with Charmosaic, a cozy, free-to-play diamond painting game. Match colors, place thousands of tiny diamonds, and watch beautiful pictures come to life. Choose from three difficulty levels and enjoy new free paintings every month.

releases.name: Train Station Staff Simulator
releases.summary: First-person sim: work at a small, new one-line station in Japan. Open up at dawn, sort out trouble at the gates, announce delays, hit the emergency stop if someone falls onto the tracks: over 60 kinds of real station work. Even with a subway line, you're one person sharing the work with your crew.

releases.name: Bust 10
releases.summary: Bust 10 is a chaotic, family-friendly party card game blending pot betting with sabotage. Bet, bluff, and use items to outsmart rivals. When someone busts, the winner smashes them with punishment props! Single-player now; online multiplayer in development.

releases.name: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
releases.summary: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

releases.name: Just a Villager MMORPG
releases.summary: You don't need to be a hero to protect someone's tomorrow. Set out as just a villager in this 8-bit MMORPG. Cross paths with other players, help each other, and uncover the world's secrets to the end. Play with strangers, friends, or solo. Then the Trial Tower awaits. Buy once, no subscription.

releases.name: Eyelord Returns
releases.summary: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

releases.name: Loop Minesweeper
releases.summary: Tired of traditional Minesweeper? Try Loop Minesweeper! Familiar rules, but the board never ends. Had enough of flat boards? Rotate a sphere and sweep mines in 3D. Want something stranger? Try negatively curved space on a Poincaré disk. Super cool.

releases.name: SoulRoad
releases.summary: Rhythm racing meets vehicular combat. Drive, drift, jump and smash to the beat across rollercoaster skies, sunset canyons and trinary star rings. Master 19 distinct rides, survive pack battles, and race your friends over LAN multiplayer.

releases.name: Arcana Rift: Tactics
releases.summary: Arcana Rift: Tactics is a turn-based tactical strategy game where Swords, Wands, Cups and Pentacles become battlefield units. Recruit your forces, craft equipment, summon powerful Arcana and destroy the enemy Tower in strategic offline or online battles.

releases.name: Night Concierge
releases.summary: You're the night concierge in a Soviet apartment block. Check faces against the resident log, watch the cameras, and decide who gets in. The “others” hide among your neighbors, and one mistake can cost a life. A PS1-style first-person horror with multiple endings and Twitch chat voting.

releases.name: Oh Baby Blocks
releases.summary: A cosy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

releases.name: Idle Demon Slayer
releases.summary: Gather a party of wandering heroes and follow a path of cultivation and demon slaying. Build your team with combat styles, talents, manuals and equipment, then take on haunted mountain trails, secret-realm bosses and an endless tower in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG.

releases.name: Voidrush (Greaver)
releases.summary: Pilot your rocket through an endless 3D tunnel, from the planet's surface into space. Dodge rotating obstacles, risk a boost for extra points and beat your personal best. Play solo or challenge up to three computer opponents. German-language interface.

releases.name: Hunter Road
releases.summary: Earn gold by capturing and dismantling monsters? Buy rifles at the shop? Defeated allies vanish forever? Welcome to the new standard of permadeath monster RPGs. Experience a retro, yet refreshingly addictive gaming adventure.

releases.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
releases.summary: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

releases.name: Unknown Depths
releases.summary: Climb down an endless, dark shaft with up to three friends. Something grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it smells you, stay in the light and it can't reach you. Hook, swing and rappel your way deeper. Can you reach the end before it breathes you in?

releases.name: Big Climb
releases.summary:
BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied together by one fully simulated rope.

It brings together everything we love about co-op games: a climb up a huge mountain like in PEAK, a shared rope where everyone holds on to each other like in Chained Together, goofy body physics and proximity voice chat like in R.E.P.O., and a monster that hunts whoever falls behind like in Lethal Company.

The rope catches on rocks, goes taut and holds whoever slipped - or drags down whoever didn't let go in time. The fast ones wait, the slow ones get hauled up, and nobody reaches the top alone.

releases.name: Tilt Siege
releases.summary: A pinball roguelite about holding a castle. An army marches down the table toward your keep: smash it with the ball, tilt the whole table to dump soldiers into the spikes, and build towers and bumpers between waves.

releases.name: Grave Mistakes
releases.summary: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

releases.name: Goshiwon
releases.summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in a cramped Korean goshiwon. You and your friend make fake ghost videos for views. But something that looks exactly like his costume gets one step closer every day.

releases.name: Touhou Auto Chess
releases.summary: Touhou Auto Chess is a single-player roguelite auto battler based on the Touhou Project. Recruit companions from Gensokyo and build diverse team compositions by combining equipment, treasures, and synergies. Discover fresh combos with your favorite characters!

releases.name: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition
releases.summary: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

releases.name: Carnival: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!

releases.name: Return to college
releases.summary: How do you define university? Beyond classes, will you shop, date, exercise, or work part-time? How will you treat roommates, classmates, and everyone you meet: friendly, warm, or cold? After graduation, study abroad, find a course-related job, or freelance? Return to university; find your answer.

releases.name: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
releases.summary: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

releases.name: Azur Promilia
releases.summary:
Azur Promilia is a fantasy world RPG with creature companionship. 

Step into a fantasy world, utterly different from the world you know. The world of various civilizations, magic and incredible fantasy creatures, together with tales echoing in the starry sky. Take a daring leap from the sky into the ocean, to once again encounter and bond with new life. Guided by shooting stars, amid the sparkling constellations, this is your very own journey. 

The entire universe eagerly anticipates the ballad of stars and odyssey, exclusively yours to unfold.

releases.name: Digging In The Desert
releases.summary: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

releases.name: The Funeral of Kay
releases.summary: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.

releases.name: Mole & Ore
releases.summary: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

releases.name: Joe Silva: Solo Trip
releases.summary: N2O Joe Silva Solo Trip is a puzzle game where the goal is to help Joe overcome obstacles, collect oranges, and rescue magic flowers to reach the final cube before the path disappears. The game features 45 unlocked levels, a minimalist visual style, and no microtransactions.

releases.name: Dice Tiny Town
releases.summary: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

releases.name: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
releases.summary: Refluff is a carpet cleaning ASMR sim built on a real fluid simulation. Scrape off dried crust, soak the pile, foam it, brush it, squeegee the slurry out and dry the fibers until the rug is spotless. Hand it over, get paid, upgrade your kit, take the next one.

releases.name: QuizForge
releases.summary: Create, play and share quizzes with friends! QuizForge combines a powerful quiz editor, local and online multiplayer, Steam Workshop support and multiple game modes into one customizable trivia experience for players, creators and communities.

releases.name: Girl's Romance of the Three Kingdoms
releases.summary: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。

releases.name: Watch My Step!
releases.summary: Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!
